'''''Science Fiction Age''''' was a Sovereign Media science-fiction magazine. The September 1996 issue included a smaller [[A New Hope Limited|A New Hope]] poster for Star Wars CCG.<ref name="enc183" />

The dated catalog is [[Magazines]]. The poster is listed on [[SWCCG Memorabilia]].
